name: Slack → Documents DB Sync

parameters.content:
## Slack → Documents DB Sync

Watches all workspace messages. When a message has a file attachment or Google Drive link, looks up the Company by Slack Channel ID and creates a 📄 Documents entry in Notion.

**Before activating:**
1. Authenticate Slack OAuth2 and Notion OAuth2
2. Ensure Slack bot is invited to all customer channels
3. Backfill Slack Channel IDs on Companies: Hensoldt, BMW, PoCo, ZF, Bosch

parameters.filterJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ property: "Slack Channel ID", rich_text: { equals: $json.channelId } }) }}

description: Watches Slack messages workspace-wide; when a file or Drive link is shared in a customer channel, looks up the Company by Slack Channel ID and creates a Documents DB entry in Notion.
